scope: Official Finnish sources related to EU, EEA and Swiss free movement; third-country family members; visa and consular routes; administrative procedure, access to information, remedies, oversight, privacy, legal aid and administrative courts. This is a bounded discovery register, not a statement of legal equivalence or complete coverage.
retrieval_status: official_current_law_links_accepted; other candidates remain under review
previous_findings_carried_forward: The Danish EU-residence regulation remains a functional comparison seed. Finland’s Aliens Act Chapter 10 is the current Finnish source for EU/EEA/Swiss residence rights; the 2007 amending act is not a separate current residence statute.

Finlex and Migri are official first-party sources. Direct Finlex consolidated pages are acceptable external references; an untested API or local conversion is optional and does not block use of those links.
The official English Aliens Act translation has an amendment cutoff of 389/2023; the English administrative-procedure translations are also older than the current Finnish texts.

The expansion taxonomy gaps in procedure, file access, consular practice, remedies, privacy, legal aid, oversight and courts were searched as separate source classes. Candidate inventory remains bounded and incomplete.
N-Lex is a discovery route for Finland’s national legal database, not a replacement for first-party Finlex, Migri, MFA, court and oversight sources.
